metaDescription: Order custom Wenger luggage travel bags with your logo. Durable, recycled materials. Bulk pricing available at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Wenger luggage travel bags combine Swiss heritage with practical design, making them a smart choice for corporate travel programs or employee gifts. The Wenger Apex 20" RPET Sport Duffle and Origins Recycled 15" Computer Backpack are crafted from recycled materials, appealing to eco-conscious buyers. These bags feature padded laptop compartments and multiple organizer pockets, ideal for business travelers. Decorate with a subtle embroidery or screen print to keep your brand visible without compromising the bag's clean look.
